data.title: 长离 · 晨起的对镜束发
data.description: 清晨镜前，她耐心地将粉发束成环形发束，每一下都精确优雅；镜中的眼神从刚醒的柔软逐渐聚焦成军师——新的一天，新的棋局。

data.promptProse: Changli arranges her pink hair into a precise ringed bundle at the morning mirror, each hand adjusting the strands carefully. Her cream long-sleeved blouse and comfortable dark trousers remain ordinary as the sleepy expression in the glass becomes focused. The medium view includes the mirror frame and dressing surface below. Sunrise lights her reflected eyes and held hair edges, with a pale sleeve reflection and gentle shadows beneath her raised arms.
